name: Kunzai Hupoli Sanqian Riye
original_name: 困在琥珀里的三千日夜
source:
She is Maple Ye, the sharpest “Mandala” in Xiji District — a ruthless mafia queen who clawed her way out of a hellish training camp. He is Ikay Lu, a calculating group CFO and financial genius who even calculates marginal costs for discounted steaks.

A long-planned betrayal binds these two parallel lives tightly together. Hunted by Yoo-chun Park, they are forced to flee and cling to every last thread of survival…

Contrasting, heart-pounding escapeBy day, she is his protector, a blade that shatters conspiracies with bullets.By night, he is her mind, frying her a medium-rare “revenge steak”.Watch this icy mob boss rediscover simple, warm humanity amid the rambling of her money-obsessed accountant.
translation:
她就是叶枫，西吉区最犀利的“曼陀罗”——从地狱般的训练营里爬出来的冷酷无情的黑手党女王。他就是伊凯·卢（Ikay Lu），一位精于计算的集团首席财务官和财务天才，甚至会计算打折牛排的边际成本。

一场蓄谋已久的背叛，将这两条平行的生活紧紧地绑在了一起。遭到朴有天的追捕，他们被迫逃离并紧紧抓住最后的生存一线……

对比鲜明、令人心跳加速的逃脱白天，她是他的保护者，一把用子弹粉碎阴谋的利刃。到了晚上，他是她的思想，为她煎一份三分熟的“复仇牛排”。看着这个冷酷的黑帮老大在她痴迷于金钱的会计师的胡言乱语中重新发现简单、温暖的人性。
